title: Combine final main rehearsal candidate: chasing, setup, accounting, AI and fonts
public_pr_body:
AE correction: FULL `npm run test:db` restored, no exclusions or skips. Serial ordering keeps every baseline file first, then all three real post-144 proof files prepare/verify the reviewed 145→146 disposable fixture. #239 access fix and #240 proofs are included. 5,446 units / 410 files passed, typecheck, targeted lint, migration checks and production build passed. No conflicts. See tests/REVIEWER-TEST-MATRIX.md for every reviewer condition and remaining database/browser runtime gaps. No SQL applied here; the helper is future CI test setup only. Assumption: local combination allowed by AA; no GitHub merges.

Final rehearsal candidate combines #233 → #236 → #237 → #234 → #242, plus AA's #239 setup role/support access fix/tests and #240 accounting company-read tests. AA merged cleanly, with no conflicts. Original X conflicts remain documented: release_preflight.sql retained both 138/144 markers; ci.yml retained both guarded release-proof stages. No feature behavior or test assertion weakened.

AA: 5,437 unit tests, typecheck and production build passed. AB final: 5,441 unit tests / 409 files passed; typecheck, targeted lint, migration freeze and release-plan checks passed; seven changed/new release/preflight SQL files parsed using pglast (syntax only, no execution). Original expanded lint limitations remain recorded for unchanged CommonJS support/generated Next types.

AB packages N5 setup as post-144 release step 145, then N2/AI cap as step 146, each with transactional prerequisite guard, exact canonical proposal body, rollback and verification copies. release-plan.json reserves both numbers and the checker rejects collisions, wrong order, missing files/markers, stale copies, and any proposal absent from preflight. Four mutation tests prove missing new/existing proposal coverage, removed phase marker, collision, dependency order and stale-copy failures. npm check:migrations includes this check. CI retains baseline catalogue/apply-twice rehearsal first, then both guarded packaged release phases and all three existing isolation/AI/race test files.

Safest-reading assumption: 145/146 are explicit one-time post-numbered release phases, outside supabase/migrations, because N2 renames functions checked by frozen 103/133/134 replay guards. Inserting it into that baseline would poison replay. Existing catalogue and baseline assertions remain unchanged, not relaxed. Preflight reports both phase markers and every proposal disposition; legacy AI body checks inspect preserved own-key aliases after 146 and the new phase marker pins the live wrappers. See tests/POST-144-RELEASE.md and tests/GO-LIVE-CANDIDATE.md. Repeat phase application refuses atomically rather than resetting keys/caps/usage.

No SQL applied or DB started, no deploy or GitHub merge. Code must rehearse baseline then 145 then 146, verification, repeat refusal/no-change, rollback, browser and two-connection cap race on the disposable backend. Chase atomic-settings release decision and deferred costing proposal remain explicitly accounted for, not silently applied. #241/#245 remain separate follow-up proof branches. No Ready label.


## Codex2 rehearsal fixes, 3 November 2026

Head d7c0019caa51f8a221e1f3b855e67f06d01ac3b4 fixes the reproduced config loader and release faults. Assumption: keep the one-time release fixture as the single installation owner, and retain all baseline/catalogue checks and the independent upgrade rehearsal.

- The sequencer imports Vitest types only. Every baseline file remains before setup, provided AI, then the cap race; no file is excluded.
- Release 145 and its proposal now call the existing scoped SECURITY DEFINER my_session API to reject support. The private _session_membership helper remains private; own-company admin checks and the support write guard stay in place. Verification and preflight match the corrected policies.
- The two redundant CI install steps are removed. The ordered fixture verifies every row of both verification files even when already installed. Existing cap/race and upgrade proofs remain. The separate diagnostic extras on claude/247-rehearsal were not changed.
- Real database assertions add ordinary/elevated support, office/workshop/viewer, outsiders and anon; positive own-admin read/insert/update; second-install refusal for 145 and 146; and refusal of 146 rollback around an actual outstanding Tolra reservation, checking retained ledger/history/functions. Existing application and financial assertions are retained. The old CI assertion requiring duplicate installs now checks the single fixture owner, every real test file and explicit proof ordering instead.

Validation: full unit suite 5,451 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; TypeScript and lint passed; release-plan and database config-load checks passed. Config load used npm run test:db -- __config_load_only__ --passWithNoTests, so no SQL or database tests ran. All real database proofs remain NOT RUN here and require Claude Code's separately authorised disposable rehearsal. No migration applied, deploy, merge or main push.

- [x] Priority config loader and 145/CI repairs: pushed to this draft.
- [ ] Next: Claude Code reruns the complete database rehearsal and diagnostic extras on the repaired head.


## Missing global provider key and rollback stop rule

Current head: `fe7514fbea7eaac2fead0237db0fa7d2abcc6db8`. Includes the already-pushed 145 policy fix and type-only sequencer fix a27dcf1.

Add a real database test in tests/db/tolra-provided-ai.test.ts with successful own-key positive controls for round-up, RFQ and assistant. After selecting Tolra-provided mode and removing the global key, all three reservation entry points must refuse with 42501 / ai_helper_off / Tolra AI is off. Full company request, usage and own-key snapshots must remain unchanged after every refusal, proving no successful fallback to the configured company key or reservation charge. No provider is called.

Assumption: the global enabled-without-key state is forbidden by the schema, so this models the valid case where a company already selected provided mode before the platform key was removed and disabled. The synthetic fixture retains enabled company features and a working own key; every change rolls back. Application behaviour and existing assertions are unchanged.

STOP RULE: rollback 146 deliberately retains ai_helper_requests.key_source, request history and usage. Do not attempt a second 146 install on that same rolled-back database. Preserve evidence and have the authorised operator reset/recreate only the disposable database to the reviewed baseline through 144, then prepare 145 and 146 in order. Never drop key_source, delete retained history, weaken a release guard or add IF NOT EXISTS to force reinstall. A live or hosted company database must never be reset for this rehearsal. The same rule is recorded in tests/REVIEWER-TEST-MATRIX.md.

Local validation: full unit suite 5,451 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; TypeScript and changed-file lint passed; database config-load command passed with no tests selected. The new real database proof is NOT RUN under the no-SQL rule. No SQL applied, database/Docker run, deploy, merge or main push.

- [x] Urgent 145/146: missing-global-key proof and reset stop rule added and pushed to this draft.
- [ ] Next: Claude Code runs the full authorised disposable database rehearsal on this exact head.
